text: Councilmember, City of Lake Forest/Businessman

Serving as your City Councilmember has been one of the greatest honors of my life. Over the past term, I have worked hard to be accessible, accountable, and committed to the residents of Lake Forest. Every decision I make is guided by a simple principle: put our community first.

Together, we have continued to strengthen public safety, maintain responsible fiscal stewardship, and preserve the high quality of life that makes Lake Forest such a wonderful place to live, work and play. I have remained focused on listening to residents, addressing neighborhood concerns, supporting local businesses, and ensuring that City Hall remains transparent and responsive.

While we have made meaningful progress, there is still important work ahead. Our city continues to face challenges and opportunities that require experienced, thoughtful leadership. I am committed to building on the progress we have made—not changing course, but continuing the steady, responsible leadership that has served our community well.

As a U.S. Army veteran, entrepreneur, and your Councilmember, I believe in service, accountability, and delivering results. I respectfully ask for your vote so we can continue working together to keep Lake Forest safe, fiscally strong, and an exceptional community for current and future generations.

text: Small Business Owner

I’ve made Lake Forest my home. As the owner of a local small business I know what actually takes to meet a budget without cutting corners. That’s the perspective I’ll bring to the city council. I’ll fight for real solutions to traffic congestion and infrastructure, not just studies. I’ll support our sheriff's deputies and push for smart, compassionate approaches to homelessness that keep our neighborhoods safe. And I will insist on the same fiscal discipline I use running my own business-no wasteful spending, no empty promises.
I’m not a career politician. I’m a neighbor, a small business owner, And a dad of three kids who wants District 2 to stay the kind of place where families choose to put down roots, because mine did.
I’d be honored to earn your vote and put my experience and what I learned in Law school to work for you and our community.
“George” Giurguis Azer

text: Mechanical Engineer

As an R&D Mechanical Engineer and long-time community advocate, I bring a practical, data-driven approach to solving complex problems. I have spent over a decade leading cross-functional teams, managing long-term technical projects, and balancing critical budgets.

As I continue to make Lake Forest a home for myself in a fresh start, I want to join you and support you by being a voice of reason and progress on our infrastructure challenges, public safety, and smart economic development for local businesses.

I am running for City Council because I love making a difference for people. I want my professional talents focused on solving the problems that matter most, on what affects you day to day. I bring with me the tenacity for improvement and innovation but also a tactful humility that comes from working on diverse teams among talented people each with their own important contribution to make.

I’ve served as a high school youth leader in my local church for 5 years and I’ve been involved in various homeless outreach and census programs. I believe in working as a team, using critical thinking and common-sense leadership to solve the problems we’re all up against.

text: Systems Analyst
Lake Forest is currently well-off financially due to major housing developments and fees paying for new city buildings and parks.

In the future we will be more dependent on property and sales tax. To keep up our city services, we’ll need to watch the money – no waste on pet projects or fighting Sacramento. This means going through budgets and contracts that cover services from wildfire mitigation to public safety to ensure our funds and values are supported. This is boring work.
I’ve been a CPA for 44 years. I do boring – carefully and proudly, and in your best interest!
I have lived in and loved Lake Forest since 1992. I’m semi-retired and would like to give back to the City. See my website below for detail.

My husband and I have raised 2 children here. I’ve volunteered with various organizations including the El Toro High School PSTO from 1996 through 2004 (Auditor, President) and on the Lake Forest Race Committee until 2015.
I’ve attended the Lake Forest Civic Academy, City Council and Audit meetings and studied the ACFR (financials).
My financial and technical background will bring complimentary perspectives to the Council.
I look forward to working for you! www.BeckyK4LakeForestCC.com

text: Community Volunteer
As a wife, mother of three, nonprofit founder, and ordained minister, I believe the strongest cities are built by strong families, connected neighborhoods, and neighbors who serve one another.
Lake Forest is more than where we live—it is our home. I am running for City Council to help preserve the safe, family-friendly community we cherish while preparing our city for a strong future.

My priorities are clear: support excellent schools that help every child succeed, champion our local businesses as the backbone of our economy, and protect the quality of life that makes Lake Forest an exceptional place to raise a family.

I believe leadership begins by listening. I want to bring our neighborhoods together, encourage greater community involvement, and build relationships that strengthen trust across our city. When we work together with respect and a shared purpose, our entire community benefits.
It would be an honor to serve Lake Forest with integrity, transparency, and a servant's heart.
Learn more at www.ThompsonForLakeForest.com.
